description: V21 reviewed wrist-to-distal-tip image directions. DX/DY are source-image vectors. The right-arm view_depth=0.25 value was selected by a documented monocular depth sweep to retain the visible elbow-high IK branch; it is not measured depth.
claim_boundary: Manual RGB review; image direction is observed, while camera-depth and image-perpendicular width axes are kinematic proxies rather than calibrated metric ground truth.
